one_line: discover and inspect public evidence, optionally authorise a request, preserve its response, reconcile nonfinal outcomes, and verify any returned card under the appropriate rule
amounts: No amount is written here. The only authority on an amount is accepts[] in the 402 you receive.
self_payments: Payments from the operator's own wallets are recorded as self-tests and never counted as buyers or revenue. Authoritative flag: settled_usdc.excludes_self=true on /api/revenue.

steps.name: discover
steps.expect: 200 JSON: x402Version, scheme, network, asset, payTo, resources[] of {method, url}

steps.name: request
steps.expect: 402 JSON; csoai.preview lists the signed cards already on file for the subject, free
HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED and JSON payment requirements. Inspect accepts[] before authorisation. Signed offer material is optional and must be checked separately when present.

steps.name: settle
steps.who_pays: the caller, from the caller's own wallet; this site holds no key for you and never settles on your behalf
steps.expect: the client signs an authorisation for the accepts[] entry and retries the same URL with the payment header

steps.name: receive
steps.expect: The inspected handler can return 200 with a commission acknowledgement or 202 with an unresolved queue or receipt outcome. Preserve the exact HTTP status, headers and raw response. A returned card may be unsigned. Neither a 200 nor a valid signature establishes execution, delivered work, a fresh measurement or root inclusion.

outcomes.meaning: A commission acknowledgement was returned. Read the explicit fields; acceptance, signature, execution and delivery are separate.
Queue acceptance is unconfirmed. Missing settlement identity can leave payment_settled null. Preserve the response and reconcile before any further payment.
The queue accepted the request but a receipt could not be assembled. Retain the available commission identity; do not automatically pay again.

retry_policy.note: Read-only reconciliation is not permission to repeat a paid request. No response, unreadable content or missing receipt does not establish that no payment occurred.

settlement_header.name: x-payment-response
settlement_header.note: Header availability depends on the handler outcome. Do not generalise this source-specific name to all x402 versions or interpret its absence as proof of nonpayment.

steps.name: verify
also: https://councilof.ai/verifier/gspc-verify.mjs for the measurement cards the receipt references
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CSOAI-ORG/councilof-ai/master/scripts/verify_receipt.py for the signed offer and receipt
steps.expect: Use the checker for the returned card rule. Exit meanings differ for an individual card-v0 payload and a GSPC card set. A nonfinal response without a card is not a verification success or proof of nonpayment.

checkers.scope: Payload-rule cards only; envelope fields outside the payload are not authenticated by this rule. Whole-card digest_covers inputs are uncheckable here.
Signature and supplied-set checks under the chosen profile; not an independent claim that every real-world record was supplied.

description_scope: Instructions derived from the named local sources, not a live transaction or a deployment assertion.
